# Marketplace-Apps Hub

> Marketplace-Apps Hub is a commercial platform providing production-grade full-stack web application templates and source code built with Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase PostgreSQL.

## Available Application Templates & Source Code

### 1. Car2Hand - Used Car Marketplace & Automotive Sales Platform
- **Slug**: car2hand
- **Status**: Available Now (v1.2.0)
- **Framework & Stack**: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, Strict TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Supabase (PostgreSQL), Lucide Icons
- **Pricing**:
  - Standard License: ฿4,900 THB ($149 USD) - Single project / 1 end product
  - Extended License: ฿12,900 THB ($389 USD) - Unlimited commercial projects & client work
- **Key Features**:
  - Bilingual support (Thai and English) with real-time THB / USD currency converter
  - Smart vehicle search and advanced filtering (EV, Sedan, SUV, Luxury, Van, Price Range, Year)
  - Real-time loan & monthly payment financing calculator
  - Test drive and vehicle booking scheduling modal
  - Comprehensive vehicle detail pages with gallery and mechanical specifications
  - Supabase PostgreSQL schema with 28 realistic car models pre-seeded
  - Zero-config offline fallback mode: runs completely without database setup
- **Live Demo**: https://car2hand.arthy001.workers.dev
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/Arthy001/car2hand

### 2. EstateSphere - Luxury Real Estate & Villa Portal
- **Slug": estatesphere
- **Status**: Coming Soon (v1.0.0)
- **Framework & Stack**: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, MapLibre GL, Supabase
- **Target Audience**: Real estate agencies, luxury villa rentals, condo developers

### 3. SwiftCart Pro - Headless E-Commerce & POS
- **Slug**: swiftcart-pro
- **Status**: In Development
- **Framework & Stack**: Next.js 15, Stripe, PromptPay QR, Supabase, Tailwind CSS v4

### 4. ClinicBook - Appointment & Clinic Management SaaS
- **Slug**: clinicbook
- **Status**: In Development
- **Framework & Stack**: Next.js 15, FullCalendar, Supabase Auth, PostgreSQL

## Technical Standard
- All templates are built with 100% TypeScript Strict Mode.
- Fully responsive on mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.
- Includes clean database schema SQL files and documentation guides.
- Delivered with full uncompiled source code.
